descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S14 「服务端写入和添加表单的智能口述带 'new admission' 文字，从不设状态（添加、病历保存、Quick Dictation 放置、Dictate all）」 Server writes and add-form smart dictation with 'new admission' text never set the status (add, chart save, Quick Dictation placement, Dictate all)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta …（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 5）
  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up（UAT TC-06）
  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 2；TFA-92584 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patients added and saved with 'New admission from the ED, admitted today…' in preRoundNotes / encounterNotes, a Quick Dictation compartment with the same words placed on them, and the Hospital Add Patient form with the speech-recognition mock (former S15)

When rounding:add, rounding:update, quickDictation:assign; 'Dictate all' on the add form with 'Patient: Ada Turing, age 72, room 4B-12, admitted for pneumonia, new admission.'

Then encType stays unset (reads Follow-up) or stays as the physician set it (Consult), and encTypeSource stays unset; the add form fills name, age and diagnosis but Encounter Type stays follow-up

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions on rounding:list; getByLabel('Encounter Type') toHaveValue('follow-up'). Hospital only: Quick Dictation is Hospital-only and the Nursing Home add form has no smart dictation on main. Does not cover the AI paths (S13, S16, S27)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
